title: Yellow Spiced Indian White Beans Rogan Josh
description: A mustardy and cozy Indian dish featuring dried white beans in a rich and aromatic rogan josh sauce, marinated in miso for added depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: dried white beans
ingredients.notes: such as cannellini or navy beans

instructions: Rinse the dried white beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the soaked beans, then transfer them to a large pot with 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the beans until they are tender, about 45 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste, mustard oil, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, and salt.
Add the chopped onion, grated ginger, and minced garlic to the bowl with the miso mixture and stir to combine.
Add the cooked white beans to the bowl with the miso mixture and stir to coat the beans evenly.
Transfer the bean mixture to a large saucepan and add 1 cup of water, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook the rogan josh sauce for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped fresh cilantro and serve the Yellow Spiced Indian White Beans Rogan Josh hot over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
